description: This is the main script for the command-line interface (CLI) of the LPT.bin to CSV converter. It handles argument parsing, logging configuration, and orchestrates the conversion process by calling functions from the converter module.

classes.name: ParserConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for parser options, specifically the skip_header option.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main function that parses arguments, sets up logging, and runs the conversion process.
